title: Completion of the leftward allocation pass
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $B>0$. Choose a schedule-symbol input, a base configuration on it, a valid input-head position, an integer budget-head position, and a budget tape. Starting in the first leftward layout phase with unary head at $1$ over the unary tape with $B$ markers and guide head at $0$ over the right guide of radius $3B$, after exactly $3B+2$ steps the machine is in the unary-reset phase, with unary head at $B$ and guide head at $-3B-1$ over the completed guide of radius $3B$.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
B is a positive natural number
base is a configuration on the chosen input
p is a valid input-head position
b is an integer budget-head position
replaced:
Let $B > 0$.  From the first leftward layout phase with unary head at cell $1$ over the
unary tape with $B$ markers and guide head at cell $0$ over the right guide of radius
$3B$, exactly $3B + 2$ steps complete the fixed guide and enter the unary-reset phase
with unary head at $B$, guide head at the left outer boundary $-3B - 1$, and guide tape
the completed guide of radius $3B$.
